name: strong-fish-ui
//typescript: This app is plain JavaScript and never imports TypeScript. The devDependency pin exists because react-scripts' own fork-ts-checker-webpack-plugin declares a non-optional 'typescript >= 2.7' peer, so npm resolves the latest major (7.x) - which violates react-scripts' own peer range of '^3.2.1 || ^4'. `npm install` tolerates the conflict, but `npm ci` validates it and refuses, which breaks the Docker build. Pinning to 4.x satisfies both ranges.
